title: Ball Pop
css: .d-drams-044{width:100%;height:320px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;background:#fff;color:#555;font:400 12px "Inter",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}.d-drams-044 *{box-sizing:border-box}.d-drams-044 button,.d-drams-044 input{font:inherit}.d-drams-044 [role=slider],.d-drams-044 button{touch-action:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}.d-drams-044 :is(button,input,[role=slider]):focus-visible{outline:2px solid #bd5b2a;outline-offset:7px}.d-drams-044 .sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.d-drams-044 *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}.d-drams-044 .pop{width:80px;height:80px;position:relative;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:50%;background:#f5f5f5;cursor:pointer}.d-drams-044 .pop:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:10px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dededc,#f3f3f3 70%);box-shadow:inset 2px 3px 4px #0000000b}.d-drams-044 .pop-ball{position:absolute;inset:11px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 33% 19%,#fff 3%,#f4f4f4 25%,#ddd 63%,#aaa 100%);box-shadow:inset 1px 1px 2px #fff,1px 4px 3px #00000022,8px 14px 15px #00000017;transform:translateY(3px) scale(.67);opacity:0;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1),opacity .15s}.d-drams-044 .pop[aria-pressed=true] .pop-ball{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-1px) scale(1)}.d-drams-044 .pop-ball svg{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:block;width:29px;height:29px;stroke:#fc762c;stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;fill:none}
prompt: Build a self-contained, accessible native HTML/CSS/JavaScript interpretation of Ball Pop from https://drams.framer.website/drams/044. Credit DRAMS by 1042 Studio (@mrblackstudio and @karimeshrimp). A white confirmation ball springs out of a shallow circular recess, showing a small orange checkmark. Press again to return it to the recess. Use a white 320px stage, soft neutral contact shadows, subtle physical edge highlights and orange details. click or press Space to pop and reset the ball. Preserve pointer and keyboard operation, reduced-motion support and the distinct geometry of this component. No hosted Framer embed or external runtime dependency.
